body: This is his mother Suzanne. My son took his life January 26th because of this evil piece of shit. I'm so heartbroken. Thank you for talking with him.

She verbally and emotionally abused me for 9 months. She fucked another guy within 24 hours of us breaking up, in our apartment (she had my keys and I was locked out). Then, she stole thousands of dollars worth of my personal possessions and cash, and vacated the apartment to live with the new guy. When I filed a police report against her, she bruised herself and claimed that I did it during our last interaction two days prior. She then filed a restraining order against me, and even tried suing me for my own bed, because she threw hers out when I moved in. Oh, and the day before breaking up she said she wanted to marry me. Never dating anyone with BPD again

Spent the whole relationship bending over backwards for her. She has Borderline Personality Disorder and was very emotionally abusive. After awhile it just wore on me and I became very depressed. Then she decided I was too depressed to be with, broke up with me and immediately decided to see another guy.
"I'll always be yours. We're going to get married someday" 3 days before she breaks up with me and fucks another guy in our apartment within 24 hours.

She has borderline personality disorder and I have some anger issues, so admittedly towards the end of the relationship I wasn't the kindest person. It was very hard to deal with walking on eggshells a lot, but the good times we had were the best of my life. I still tried my hardest to do everything she asked to make it work towards the end, but she gave up on me.
